name: default_capacity_provider_strategy
description: Map of default capacity provider strategy definitions to use for the cluster

name: task_exec_ssm_param_arns
description: List of SSM parameter ARNs the task execution role will be permitted to get/read

name: region
description: Region where the resource(s) will be managed. Defaults to the Region set in the provider configuration

name: service_connect_defaults
description: Configures a default Service Connect namespace

name: create_task_exec_iam_role
description: Determines whether the ECS task definition IAM role should be created

name: task_exec_iam_role_permissions_boundary
description: ARN of the policy that is used to set the permissions boundary for the IAM role

name: task_exec_iam_role_policies
description: Map of IAM role policy ARNs to attach to the IAM role

name: task_exec_iam_statements
description: A map of IAM policy [statements](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/data-sources/iam_policy_document#statement) for custom permission usage

name: create
description: Determines whether resources will be created (affects all resources)

name: configuration
description: The execute command configuration for the cluster

name: name
description: Name of the cluster (up to 255 letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores)

name: setting
description: List of configuration block(s) with cluster settings. For example, this can be used to enable CloudWatch Container Insights for a cluster

name: cloudwatch_log_group_retention_in_days
description: Number of days to retain log events

name: task_exec_iam_role_name
description: Name to use on IAM role created

name: task_exec_iam_role_path
description: IAM role path

name: task_exec_iam_role_description
description: Description of the role

name: create_cloudwatch_log_group
description: Determines whether a log group is created by this module for the cluster logs. If not, AWS will automatically create one if logging is enabled

name: cloudwatch_log_group_name
description: Custom name of CloudWatch Log Group for ECS cluster

name: cloudwatch_log_group_kms_key_id
description: If a KMS Key ARN is set, this key will be used to encrypt the corresponding log group. Please be sure that the KMS Key has an appropriate key policy (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/encrypt-log-data-kms.html)

name: autoscaling_capacity_providers
type:
map(object({
    auto_scaling_group_arn = string
    managed_draining       = optional(string, "ENABLED")
    managed_scaling = optional(object({
      instance_warmup_period    = optional(number)
      maximum_scaling_step_size = optional(number)
      minimum_scaling_step_size = optional(number)
      status                    = optional(string)
      target_capacity           = optional(number)
    }))
    managed_termination_protection = optional(string)
    name                           = optional(string) # Will fall back to use map key if not set
    tags                           = optional(map(string), {})
  }))
description: Map of autoscaling capacity provider definitions to create for the cluster

name: task_exec_iam_role_use_name_prefix
description: Determines whether the IAM role name (`task_exec_iam_role_name`) is used as a prefix

name: task_exec_iam_role_tags
description: A map of additional tags to add to the IAM role created

name: create_task_exec_policy
description: Determines whether the ECS task definition IAM policy should be created. This includes permissions included in AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy as well as access to secrets and SSM parameters

name: task_exec_secret_arns
description: List of SecretsManager secret ARNs the task execution role will be permitted to get/read

name: tags
description: A map of tags to add to all resources

name: cloudwatch_log_group_class
description: Specified the log class of the log group. Possible values are: `STANDARD` or `INFREQUENT_ACCESS`

name: cloudwatch_log_group_tags
description: A map of additional tags to add to the log group created
